shortDescription: Middle East sovereign wealth funds have advised South Africa to set up a fundraising vehicle for a new state firm that would manage its 155 billion-rand ($9.5 billion) property portfolio, according to Bloomberg.The funds are backed by trillions of dollars in assets.

title: South Africa Seeks Gulf Advice on $9.5 Billion Property Fund
